competitors.name: Target
competitors.action: Target told Progressive Grocer that new food-and-beverage items generated $2 billion in sales last year and that the retailer has added roughly 5,000 food-and-beverage items in 2026. Target said emerging brands are an important source of new ideas, but merchants require genuine differentiation and repeat purchase rather than buzz alone; the retailer uses its Discovery Day open call and Innovation Collective to identify and develop assortment candidates.

trends.topic: Large retailers using product newness to drive food sales while screening emerging brands for repeatability
trends.magnitude: $2 billion in Target food sales from newness last year; roughly 5,000 food-and-beverage items added in 2026
trends.context: Progressive Grocer published the interview Oct. 12. Target did not break out frozen or pizza performance, so this is an account-level merchandising signal rather than category data. The relevant implication for Real Dough is that a differentiated product story can open the door, but Target's stated bar is repeat purchase: account reviews should pair sourdough and premium-positioning claims with velocity, repeat and incrementality evidence.

market_data.value: $2 billion in food sales from newness last year
market_data.change: Roughly 5,000 food-and-beverage items added so far in 2026

breaking.headline: EXCLUSIVE: How Target Is Adapting Its Food & Beverage Assortment for Today's Shoppers
